projects.title: NeuroNode
projects.subtitle: Custom STM32-based wireless sensor module
projects.description: A compact, low-power wireless sensor module built around an STM32L4 microcontroller. Features onboard BME688 environmental sensing, custom KiCad PCB layout, LoRa radio for long-range telemetry, and a FreeRTOS task scheduler. Designed for deployment in remote field environments with a 6-month battery target.

projects.title: Distributed Environment Dashboard
projects.subtitle: Real-time sensor mesh with live MQTT telemetry and visual analytics
projects.description: A high-throughput IoT sensor network monitoring indoor and outdoor air quality, temperature, and relative humidity. Utilizing low-power ESP32 nodes communicating via ESP-NOW, bridged to an MQTT server. The frontend features real-time visualizations built using WebSockets, rendering live metrics.

projects.title: Synapse
projects.subtitle: Real-time distributed task orchestration system
projects.description: A distributed job orchestration platform written in Go, designed for coordinating multi-node embedded device fleets. Features a gRPC control plane, Redis-backed job queue, Prometheus metrics, and a React dashboard for real-time fleet status monitoring.

projects.title: TermFlow CLI
projects.subtitle: Lightweight terminal-based environment config and script runner
projects.description: A blazing fast CLI developer tool built in Go for managing workspace configurations, project initialization templates, and multi-process shell runner. Features local cache management, custom shell-script pipelines, and auto-completions.
